prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one food-selection sticker for the Super Nutrition mobile app.
Primary request: PEANUTS only: a compact cluster of shelled peanuts with reddish-brown skins and two pale peanut kernel halves beside one opened tan peanut shell. Peanuts must have recognizable smaller oblong kernel shapes and the coarse double-lobed shell. No almonds or other nuts.
Style/medium: crisp photorealistic food cutout with natural texture and gentle soft studio lighting, matching the existing mixed-nuts, rice and peeled-banana stickers with a thin clean white die-cut outline around the food silhouette.
Composition/framing: one coherent centered three-quarter food cluster on a square transparent canvas, complete food and outline visible inside the central 78 percent. Keep clear transparent padding on every edge.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha background, no scene or cast shadow. No plate, bowl, board, table, utensils, packaging, unrelated ingredients, green backing, text, letters, badges, checkmarks, faces, watermark or UI.
visual_result: Visually inspected: recognizable textured double-lobed peanut shells, red-skinned oblong kernels and two pale kernel halves, distinct from almonds; full white-outlined food cluster on transparency.
